ask: Priya finally gave us her LinkedIn login. Connect her so her drafts start going out.

steps.why: Priya's row shows token_status ghost: added without connecting, so Bolta wrote for it but it can't post. Not disconnected, so no reconnect wording. Connecting alone won't release her drafts, so the reply says: "In Bolta, open Brand > Accounts (bolta.ai/dashboard/knowledge-base?tab=accounts), press Connect LinkedIn on Priya's row and sign in to LinkedIn as Priya (Priya herself, or whoever she gave the login to; it must be her LinkedIn, not yours), then say yes to moving Priya's voice and drafts. Tell me when it's done." Not get-connect-link: started there, Bolta doesn't offer the move.

After the user says it's done in Bolta. The ghost row gone and a valid LinkedIn row for Priya means the move happened. A new valid row but the ghost still there: connected but not moved, so her drafts are still held; point to the row's "Already connected?" button.

Her scheduled queue: account_ids lists the scheduled posts on that account, soonest first. Moved drafts go out at their chosen time if still ahead, else the next free slot. Read the times back instead of promising them.

say: Priya's LinkedIn is connected and her voice and drafts moved to it. Her 3 approved posts are scheduled for Tue 9:07 am, Thu 12:23 pm and next Mon 9:15 am.
never: Sending get-connect-link and saying her drafts will now post: connecting alone releases nothing.
Calling her account disconnected or offering a reconnect.
Saying the move happened before the account list shows the ghost row gone.
